propositions: Agents file bugs outside an epic's hierarchy that are undetected by the direct-children gate because they lack explicit parent linkage; the gate must detect open/in_progress bugs with caused_by edges into the epic subtree as deterministic blocks (DET floor).

The candidate filter must identify open/in_progress bugs created after the epic's first in_progress transition OR linked to the epic subtree (any relation, both directions) to capture unlinked orphans; screen output is capped at 32 candidates with overflow tracking.

A forced-choice haiku relevance screen (A: deliverable-defect, B: pre-existing/adjacent, C: unrelated) classifies candidates without LLM context squeeze; only A-verdicts (up to 8 compact rows) are forwarded to the verifier via the precheck-assembled fenced context.

The verifier adjudicates via store-grounded show_ticket inspection and blocks only undispositioned defects-in-deliverable, where disposition is satisfied by (a) supersedes/duplicates link to epic subtree or successor, or (b) reasoned pre-existence/deferral prose in bug description/comments; bare 'out of scope' does not qualify.
Screen failure degrades open (log + skip) without blocking; DET floor is the hard deterministic tier; --force-close remains the operator escape hatch.

Commit-relation criterion is rejected (0 unique catches, 2 FPs, 58% of cited SHAs unresolvable); the three-stage gate (DET floor + filter + haiku screen + verifier disposition rule) teaches agents to fix, re-parent, or dispute links rather than avoid linking.
